subject: MAP: evaluation & legal sequencing — MSA/DPA/order-form takedown plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — evaluation scope + legal sequencing

Alex — attaching a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to align evaluation milestones with procurement/legal steps. High level: we want a 6–8 week evaluation window with a coordinated signature path (MSA + DPA + Order Form). This note calls out dependencies we see and asks for procurement/legal owners on your side so we can lock calendar windows.

Key milestones (proposed):
- Week 0: NDA done; kickoff scoping call
- Week 1–3: Pilot/eval — feature checklist + SLO targets (we'll provide acceptance tests)
- Week 4: Pilot review + decision to proceed to commercial terms
- Week 5–6: Legal review (MSA + DPA redlines) and Order Form finalization
- Week 7: Signatures + onramp plan

Dependencies we need to clarify:
- Veridian legal will require the DPA redline before we start storing test PHI in the pilot environment (if that becomes necessary).
- Order form needs a clear billing contact + purchasing PO terms — otherwise procurement may request a revised payment timeline.
- If the MSA review is expected to take longer than 10 business days, we should enable an interim engineering access agreement to avoid blocking the eval.

Please review the attached MAP_Veridian_v1.xlsx and redwood-dpa-draft.pdf. If you can, confirm: 1) who is the legal owner and procurement lead on your side, 2) any statutory compliance reviewers we should include (privacy/security), and 3) target sign date range you prefer.

Happy to jump on a short alignment call this week — propose Wed 10/6 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Veridian_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-dpa-draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@veridianhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procure@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation scope + legal sequencing

Vanessa — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. High level response from Veridian: we like the phased approach. A few quick notes from procurement/legal:

- Legal owner: I copied our Sr. Counsel, Dana Li, on the thread (she's looped via procurement@ but will join if we progress).
- Procurement lead: I'm cc'ing procurement@ (they manage PO timing and platform approvals). They ask that order-form line items be constrained to an approved price list (we'll share if you provide list/sku mapping).
- DPA: we need to run your DPA through our privacy office; expect 7–12 business days for initial review unless redlines are minimal.

We can tentatively commit to the week-of-Nov 8 signature window but would prefer to keep the evaluation moving in parallel to reduce calendar drift. Wed 10/6 10am PT works for a kickoff call for us.

Two asks for your team before the call:
1) a one-pager that lists exactly what data types will be used in the pilot (PII/PHI/no-PHI) and any retention/cache behavior;
2) an order-form sketch with sku/price bands so procurement can pre-check budget/approval gates.

—Alex
Head of Innovation
Veridian Health Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@veridianhealth.com>, procurement <procure@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation scope + legal sequencing

Thanks Alex / Vanessa — captured a sequencing sketch below after reviewing the DPA draft and product-side constraints. I'm flagging the places we need explicit signoffs to keep the eval-to-sign path tight.

Sequencing & gating (recommended):
1) Data & risk gating (Day 0–3) — Veridian confirms pilot data types. If PHI is involved, require privacy ok + limited retention policy. No PHI => standard pilot SLA.
2) Pilot environment access (Day 3–7) — engineering handoff; redwood provides acceptance test harness. We will limit token logging for the pilot by default.
3) Pilot execution + acceptance (Week 1–3) — run acceptance tests; record quality metrics and latency/cost reports.
4) Commercial intent sign (End of Week 3) — Veridian confirms intent to proceed; procurement begins formal PO process.
5) MSA & DPA parallel review (Week 4–5) — legal teams exchange redlines. We propose a single consolidated redline document for each (MSA and DPA) and a 7-business-day cadence for reply cycles.
6) Order Form finalization (Week 5–6) — pricing, SLOs, billing contacts, PO terms.
7) Signature & cutover (Week 7) — DocuSign sign + onramp runbook.

Risk items that typically slow us down:
- DPA iterations with privacy counsel requesting architecture diagrams or separate SOC artifacts. We can pre-send a SOC summary and high-level architecture if that helps speed review.
- PO approval requiring an alternate vendor checklist or legal exceptions. Procurement, please confirm what docset you need to fast-track approvals (e.g., W-9, invoice templates, security self-attestation).

Action items (owners):
- Vanessa / Redwood: circulate one-pager on data retention and a compact order-form sketch by Mon 10/15 (Vanessa to own).
- Veridian (Alex / procurement): confirm legal owner (Dana) availability for a 30-min redline sync week of 10/19 and confirm required procurement docs.
- Karthik: I'll prep the SOC summary and an architecture diagram; will drop links to those in the MAP.

I'll mark this as the working plan in the attached MAP spreadsheet so we have dates tied to each gate. Sean — can you comment if you want a separate acceptance runbook itemized (I can draft).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Legal & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks for the quick alignment. Per Karthik's plan we've updated the MAP and attached the one-pager and order-form sketch. Summary of next steps and concrete dates:

- 10/27: Vanessa -> deliver pilot data one-pager + updated order-form sketch (attached).
- 10/28: Veridian privacy review kickoff (Dana / privacy) — target initial DPA comments by 11/08.
- 11/01–11/21: Pilot window (acceptance tests run during this period).
- 11/22–11/29: Legal finalization window (MSA+DPA redline convergence).
- 11/30–12/03: Signatures and commercial kick-off.

We included an interim access provision in the MAP: if Veridian confirms no-PHI in the pilot, we provision a short-term engineering access that limits logs/retention; if PHI is required, we will wait for DPA sign-off.

Please review the attached MAP_Veridian_v2.xlsx (attached draft) and the DocuSign preview link below for the order-form. If those look good, we can lock the 11/30 signature window and I will schedule a 30-min redline sync with Dana for the week of 10/19 as Karthik suggested.
